title: Low-loss sintered Ni-Zn-Cu ferrite sheets for 85 kHz to 150 kHz high-power inductive couplers
text: We demonstrate a novel composition of Ni-Zn-Cu ferrite with Bi2O3 grain-boundary doping yielding 42% lower core losses at 100 kHz (B=100 mT, 80°C) while maintaining saturation flux density of 410 mT. This enables 15 kW automotive wireless charging pads with reduced thickness.

title: Top 10 Gadgets to Watch at CES This Year
text: From curved OLED TVs to smart toothbrushes with Bluetooth, here is our annual roundup of consumer electronics making waves on the showroom floor in Las Vegas.

title: Method for in-situ polymerization of polyacrylic acid binders in high-loading silicon microparticle anodes
text: A method for coating 90 wt% micro-silicon particles with self-crosslinking polyacrylic acid (PAA) doped with conductive carbon nanotubes, achieving >88% capacity retention over 800 cycles without electrolyte starvation.

title: Global Market for Consumer Electronics Expected to Grow at 4.2% CAGR
text: A new research report highlights market trends across North America and Asia Pacific, citing rising smartphone adoption and disposable income as key drivers through 2030.

title: Optoelectronic matrix multiplier using phase-change materials for non-volatile in-memory optical computing
text: We report an 8x8 integrated photonic crossbar using Sb2Se3 phase-change materials on silicon nitride waveguides, performing zero-static-power optical matrix-vector multiplications at 10 GHz clock rate with 8-bit equivalent precision.

title: Tech Startup Raises $35M Series B for Enterprise CRM Automation
text: CloudSaaS Inc announced a $35 million Series B financing round led by Horizon Ventures to expand sales teams and build customer support chatbots for retail businesses.

title: IonPulse closes $24M Series A to commercialize solvent-free dry coating of sulfide solid-state electrolytes
text: IonPulse Energy announced $24 million in Series A funding to scale roll-to-roll dry powder coating for Li6PS5Cl argyrodite solid electrolyte films at 10 m/min line speed, targeting EV battery cell manufacturers.

title: DOE Mandate on Commercial Electric Vehicle Dynamic Wireless Charging Standards (SAE J2954/2)
text: The Department of Energy issued rulemaking establishing interoperability specifications for high-power (50 kW - 200 kW) inductive wireless power transfer for heavy-duty commercial fleet corridors, mandating 85 kHz center frequency compliance.

title: Weekly Podcast: Why Artificial Intelligence is Changing How We Write Emails
text: Join our hosts as they chat with freelance writers about how generative AI helps them brainstorm newsletter topics faster.

title: Sub-threshold analog compute-in-memory ReRAM macro with 45 TOPS/W for ultra-low power keyword spotting
text: A 28nm monolithic ReRAM test chip operating in sub-threshold current regimes achieves 45.2 TOPS/W energy efficiency with on-chip temperature drift compensation across -40°C to 125°C.

title: Company Press Release: Q3 Financial Results Conference Call Announcement
text: Corporation XYZ will host its quarterly earnings conference call on Tuesday at 4:30 PM EST. Dial-in details and webcast access are available on the investor relations portal.

title: Widefield quantum diamond NV magnetometry for operando detection of lithium dendrite nucleation
text: Using a 50 µm thick single-crystal diamond sensor plate with dense surface NV centers, we image stray magnetic fields produced by localized current channeling in solid-state cells, identifying micro-short dendrites 20 hours before thermal runaway.

title: Opinion: Five Ways Remote Work is Reshaping Coffee Consumption
text: Urban cafes report shifts in foot traffic as hybrid work schedules alter weekday morning routines across metropolitan areas.

title: Gallium nitride on diamond substrate with direct thermal via integration for 30 W/mm power density
text: A GaN-on-diamond semiconductor structure incorporating etched through-substrate micro-vias metallized with chemical vapor deposited copper, reducing peak junction temperature by 38°C under 10 GHz radar pulsed operation.

title: EU Critical Raw Materials Act Enforces 15% Recycled Neodymium and Dysprosium in Electric Motors by 2030
text: European Commission adopted mandatory quotas for closed-loop recycling and substitution of heavy rare earth elements (Dy, Tb) in permanent magnet motors and multi-layer ceramic components.

title: Celebrity Endorsement Deals in E-Commerce Platforms for 2026
text: An overview of influencer marketing contracts and branding agencies negotiating social media sponsorships across video platforms.

title: Bio-resorbable PEDOT-silk fibroin microelectrode arrays for transient intra-cortical recording
text: Ultra-flexible neural probes fabricated from conductive PEDOT:PSS interpenetrated with silk fibroin hydrogel dissolve safely in cerebral tissue after 90 days, eliminating surgical explantation requirements while maintaining 100 µV recording fidelity.

title: 3D-printed auxetic metamaterial gripper with embedded galinstan fluidic channels for continuous tactile force feedback
text: A compliant robotic soft finger combining negative Poisson ratio elastomer lattices with multi-chamber Galinstan liquid metal pressure channels, measuring 0.01 N shear and normal contact force simultaneously at 200 Hz.

title: Local Bakery Wins Award for Best Sourdough Loaf in Regional Competition
text: Judges praised the crisp crust and traditional fermentation techniques used by the family-owned bakery in downtown Springfield.

title: Neuromorphic Vision Sensor Startup Prophesee raises $50M from strategic chipmakers
text: Event-based vision sensor pioneer secures growth capital to integrate asynchronous pixel sensors with on-chip sparse spiking neural networks for ultra-low latency gesture and high-speed robotic tracking.
